after #74 I get this error
/opt/ros/indigo/lib/libtf.so: undefined reference to `tf2::BufferCore::_allFramesAsDot() const'

to reproduce: create a workspace with the ros/velodyne repo and the ros/geometry_experimental repo, both of them checked out to the latest version.

I bisected on ros/geometry_experimental and I confirmed #74 is the culprit

notes: All key claims verified. (1) Issue 84 body verbatim: 'after #74 I get this error /opt/ros/indigo/lib/libtf.so: undefined reference to `tf2::BufferCore::_allFramesAsDot() const' ... I bisected on ros/geometry_experimental and I confirmed #74 is the culprit'. (2) PR 74 'change _allFramesAsDot() -> _allFramesAsDot(double current_time)' (merged cbcc785c, 2015-03-03); its files diff contains exactly '-  std::string _allFramesAsDot() const; / +  std::string _allFramesAsDot(double current_time = 0) const;' (failed condition #0 quote verbatim). (3) PR 86 'Use overloading instead of default arguments' ('Fixes #84') merged as commit 04810475 (2015-03-12), whose parents are 12605ab6 (indigo-devel) and de715513 (fix_84 head) — matching the spec's resolved_rev and revision_basis. Note: the GitHub API's PR 86 merge_commit_sha (eeed80d7) returns 'No commit found' (HTTP 422), but the actual merge commit 04810475 is verified directly. However I've also attempted a rework to overload instead of have a default method.'; 78406186 'I patched fix_84 for _allFramesAsDOT as well.'; reporter 78407496 'yep that fixes it!'. tfoote's reproduction shows the same linker class for allFramesAsYAML ('undefined reference to `tf2::BufferCore::allFramesAsYAML() const' / collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status'). (6) Two failed conditions describe one declaration change from two sides: source-level element_retyped (defaulted parameter added, element still present) and binary-level element_removed_or_renamed (default args expand in the caller, so the zero-arg symbol is no longer exported); both classes and the single implicated element _allFramesAsDot are correct. (7) Loudness loud_documented + build (linker error). (8) Resolution 'observed': reporter confirms the fix_84 branch (byte-identical to 04810475) fixes the unchanged indigo binary libtf.so. No missed conditions in this composition (the allFramesAsYAML/tf2_ros failure is a different tf2_ros<->tf2 composition).
